<mxfile host="Electron" scale="0.55" border="15"> <diagram name="Page-1" id="z5_L1BhBzgsqQlKa-2KL"> <mxGraphModel dx="1660" dy="2089" grid="1" gridSize="10" guides="1" tooltips="1" connect="1" arrows="1" fold="1" page="1" pageScale="1" pageWidth="827" pageHeight="1169" math="0" shadow="0"> <root> <mxCell id="0" /> <mxCell id="1" parent="0" /> <UserObject label="" mermaidData="{
 "data": "block-beta
 columns 5

 space:2
 TIME[\"DIM_TIME<br/>Calendar & Temporal Context\"]
 space:2

 CUSTOMER[\"DIM_CUSTOMER<br/>Canonical OCB Customer\"]
 space
 FACT[\"FACT_REPAYMENT<br/><br/>Grain: One row per<br/>SikaCredit repayment\"]
 space
 GEOGRAPHY[\"DIM_GEOGRAPHY<br/>Repayment Location\"]

 space:2
 INSTITUTION[\"DIM_INSTITUTION<br/>Financial Institution\"]
 space:2

 CUSTOMER --> FACT
 TIME --> FACT
 INSTITUTION --> FACT
 GEOGRAPHY --> FACT

 space:5

 LOAN[\"FACT_LOAN<br/><br/>Referenced by loan_id\"]
 
 FACT --> LOAN

 space:5

 NOTES[\"NOTES<br/><br/>• Conceptual star schema; not a physical table design.<br/>• Grain: one row per SikaCredit repayment.<br/>• dim_customer uses the canonical OCB customer key: ocb_customer_id.<br/>• dim_geography represents repayment location, not customer location.<br/>• Exact repayment timestamp remains on the fact for temporal analysis.<br/>• loan_id links each repayment to its originating loan in fact_loan.<br/>• No separate dim_loan is introduced in v1.0.0.<br/>• Analytical measures and derived intelligence are excluded from this conceptual view.\"]",
 "config": null

div.span:
NOTES
• Conceptual star schema; not a physical table design.
• Grain: one row per SikaCredit repayment.
• dim_customer uses the canonical OCB customer key: ocb_customer_id.
• dim_geography represents repayment location, not customer location.
• Exact repayment timestamp remains on the fact for temporal analysis.
• loan_id links each repayment to its originating loan in fact_loan.
• No separate dim_loan is introduced in v1.0.0.
• Analytical measures and derived intelligence are excluded from this conceptual view.
